title: fix(datasets): raise instead of looping forever when no sample survives

files.patch:
@@ -265,6 +265,7 @@ def __init__(
 
     def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[Dict[str, List[int]]]:
         while True:
+            yielded_any = False
             for row in self.dataset:
                 mapped = {dest: row[src] for dest, src in self.column_mapping.items() if src in row}
                 # Skip rows missing required fields
@@ -276,10 +277,18 @@ def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[Dict[str, List[int]]]:
                     continue
                 if not _check_all_values_equal_length(tokenized):
                     continue
+                yielded_any = True
                 yield tokenized
 
             if not self.repeat_on_exhaustion:
                 return
+            if not yielded_any:
+                # Looping again would never produce a sample and training would hang silently.
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "No valid samples were produced from a full pass over the dataset. Check that "
+                    "column_mapping refers to existing columns (including the answer column) and that "
+                    "samples are not all filtered out (empty labels or mismatched lengths)."
+                )
             # Wrap-around: advance epoch for deterministic reshuffle if supported and iterate again
             try:
                 self._current_epoch_for_repeat += 1

@@ -181,3 +181,21 @@ def test_iterable_dataset_mapping_checks_invalid_num_columns(tmp_path: Path):
             column_mapping={"answer": "a"},  # only 1 key
             tokenizer=_DummyTokenizer(),
         )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.timeout(30)
+def test_iterable_dataset_raises_when_every_row_is_filtered(tmp_path: Path):
+    # The answer column does not exist in the data, so every row is skipped. Without a guard
+    # the repeat-on-exhaustion loop spins forever without yielding.
+    jsonl_path = tmp_path / "toy_no_answer_column.jsonl"
+    _write_jsonl(jsonl_path, [{"q": "Q0?", "a": "A0"}, {"q": "Q1?", "a": "A1"}])
+
+    ds = ColumnMappedTextInstructionIterableDataset(
+        path_or_dataset_id=str(jsonl_path),
+        column_mapping={"question": "q", "answer": "missing"},
+        tokenizer=_DummyTokenizer(),
+        answer_only_loss_mask=False,
+    )
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="No valid samples"):
+        next(iter(ds))
